grouping.limits: Scalar Boolean identity only; stateful/unknown address replicas remain atoms. No RAM adapter, board-state classification, CE rewrite, global barrier, restore or FPGA timing proof. Indexed storage-delay branch stays opaque; no alternate parameter configuration is qualified.

manifest.scope: Complete modeled frozen native MemD,STORAGE_INPUT_DELAY=2 only;2-state. External consumers/inputs,global barrier,device/ARM state and physical machine snapshot excluded.
